ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (black) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels, with black pigmentation covering >95% of the visible ventral surface area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations (jagged peaks and valleys) extracted along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased irregularity at the distal terminal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex sweep along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to sharp upward curves at the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast white circular pixel clusters detected on the extreme outer tips of both lobes; additional isolated circular marks present in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense white scarring or barnacle colonization visible at both distal terminal tips of the fluke lobes.
